scope: Derived actual good physical and good auxiliary density product identity; no merge-moment estimate.
checks: The definition is the partial trace of the same actual excitation component after explicit regrouping.
Both good physical and auxiliary coordinates use the same chosen enumeration.
The product theorem has only unit normalization of the prescribed one-copy ground vector.
No independence, permutation fixedness, supplied product identity or auxiliary marginal certificate is assumed.
Zero components, k=0 and empty good sets are included.
General partial-trace composition and Kronecker trace results remain private.
